content: उ I. €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> (अवते, ऊवे, औष्ट, ओतुम्, उत) .²1 To sound, make a noise. .²2 To roar, bellow (as a bull <ab>&c.</ab>). --II. €5 <ab>P.</ab> (उनोति) <ab>Ved.</ab> To ask, demand.

उः .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva, the second of the three syllables in ओम्; see अ. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Brahmā. .²3 The orb of the moon; <ab>cf.</ab> also उर्गौरीपतिरुः कालः सेतुर्नाथः परायणः . नारदोऽर्कोऽनिलः पाशी मार्कण्डेयोऽथ रावणः .. <ls>Enm.</ls> --{%ind.%} .²1 As a particle used expletively; उ उमेशः <ls>Sk.</ls> .²2 An interjection of:-- .³({%a%}) calling; उ मेति मात्रा तपसो निषिद्धा पश्चादुमाख्यां सुमुखी जगाम <ls>Ku. 1. 26</ls>; .³({%b%}) anger; .³({%c%}) compassion; .³({%d%}) command; .³({%e%}) acceptance; .³({%f%}) interrogation; उ मेति मात्रा तपसो निषिद्धा <ls>Ku. 1. 26</ls>. .³({%g%}) wonder; यत्सन्निधावहमु खाण्डवमग्नयेऽदाम् <ls>Bhāg. 1. 15. 8</ls>. or used merely as an expletive. In the Veda used as an enclitic copula implying restriction and emphasis (and, but, on the other hand, now, I ask <ab>&c.</ab>); in classical literature used chiefly with अथ (अथो), न ({@नो@}) and किम् (किमु); see these words. उ--उ or उत on the one hand-on the other hand, partly-partly.
